subject: Demo scheduling: proposed rotating cadence and overlap windows (Novacorp)

Subject: Scheduling: proposed rotating cadence and overlap windows (Novacorp)

Hi Ian —

Thanks for the quick sync on the call earlier. To make sure we get the right folks from both sides (AE + SE + your infra/procurement/security), I put together a few concrete options that balance early US overlap with a later EU/APAC slot. The goal is a short technical demo (30–40m) + 20m Q&A, run twice on a rotating cadence so your global team can join at least one slot per week.

Attached: Redwood-demo-availability-grid.xlsx (spreadsheet with proposed windows).

Proposed cadence (examples):
- Option A (US-friendly this week): Tue 10:00–11:00 PT / Wed 19:00–20:00 CEST / Thu 02:00–03:00 SGT — rotate next week to favor APAC.
- Option B (EMEA-focused): Wed 15:00–16:00 CEST / Wed 06:00–07:00 PT / Thu 22:00–23:00 SGT.
- Option C (rotating handshake): week 1 = US prime; week 2 = EMEA prime; week 3 = APAC prime — repeat.

Attendees we suggest per session:
- AE (me) — product overview + commercial next steps
- SE (Marcus) — live demo, technical deep-dive
- Customer: lead engineers, security contact, procurement rep

Can you confirm: 1) who from Novacorp must attend (names/titles), 2) any blackout days next two weeks, and 3) whether procurement requires a formal PO kickoff before demos?

If you prefer, I can send a templated rotating calendar invite (Proposed-cadence.ics) so your team can pick recurring slots.

Thanks — I put the most likely overlap windows highlighted on the spreadsheet. Happy to iterate.

Best,
